sentences.text: Welcome to our factory, where fresh bread is made every day.
sentences.translation: 欢迎来到我们的工厂,这里每天都会生产新鲜的面包。

chunks.label: 从句(非限制性定语从句)
chunks.text: where fresh bread is made every day

grammar.name: 被动语态 is made

grammar.name: where 引导非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: where 修饰 factory,补充说明"在这个工厂里"发生的事。

sentences.text: The wheat is cleaned first, and then it is ground with care.
sentences.translation: 小麦先被清洗,然后被仔细地磨碎。

grammar.name: 一般现在时被动语态
grammar.note: is cleaned / is ground 都是 be+过去分词,强调动作本身而不是谁做的。

grammar.name: and then 然后
grammar.note: and then 表示动作的先后顺序,"先……然后……"。

grammar.name: for + 时间段

sentences.text: The bread is shaped by hand, and then it is put into a hot oven to bake.
sentences.translation: 面包被手工塑形,然后被放进热烤箱里烘烤。

grammar.name: 被动语态 is put
grammar.note: put 的过去分词仍是 put(不规则动词),be+put 表示"被放"。

sentences.text: After baking, the bread is packed into a big box and is sent to another city.
sentences.translation: 烘烤之后,面包被装进大箱子,并被运往另一个城市。

grammar.name: 被动语态 is packed / is sent
grammar.note: 两个并列的被动谓语,表示"被包装、被运送"。

sentences.text: Every day, about a thousand loaves are produced by our factory.
sentences.translation: 每天,我们工厂大约生产一千条面包。

sentences.text: The factory was built in 1990, and it was improved last year.
sentences.translation: 这家工厂建于1990年,去年进行了改进。

grammar.name: 一般过去时被动语态
grammar.note: was built / was improved 是 be(was)+过去分词,表示过去发生的被动动作。

grammar.name: in 1990 时间状语
grammar.note: in+年份表示"在某一年",last year 表示"去年"。

sentences.text: You are warmly welcomed here, and your question is always answered by our staff.
sentences.translation: 你们在这里受到热情的欢迎,你们的问题总会得到我们员工的解答。

grammar.name: 被动语态 welcome / answer
grammar.note: are warmly welcomed 和 is answered 表示"被欢迎、被解答"。

grammar.name: 副词修饰被动语态
grammar.note: warmly、always 是副词,放在 be 动词与过去分词之间或之前。

exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):You are warmly welcomed here, and your question is always answered by our staff.
exercises.answer: You are warmly welcomed here, and your question is always answered by our staff.
exercises.note: are warmly welcomed 和 is answered 表示"被欢迎、被解答"。

exercises.note: warmly、always 是副词,放在 be 动词与过去分词之间或之前。

sentences.text: Remember, quality is checked carefully, because safety is crucial for us, and the bread is delivered to the shop on time.
sentences.translation: 请记住,质量会被仔细检查,因为安全对我们至关重要,而且面包会被准时送到商店。

chunks.label: 主干(被动语态)
chunks.text: the bread is delivered to the shop on time

grammar.name: 被动语态 is checked
grammar.note: is checked 表示"被检查",carefully 修饰被检查的方式。

grammar.name: 被动语态 is delivered
grammar.note: is delivered to the shop 表示"被送到商店",on time 表示"准时"。
